sources.entry: CoverNice - KDP cover studio: five directions, spine width from page count, 300 dpi wrap PDF. #freemium

summary.name: CoverNice
summary.one_liner: CoverNice is an AI book cover generator that creates cover directions from a book's title, author and description and exports print-ready KDP wraps at 300 dpi.
use_cases: Creating a book cover without design skills
Preparing a KDP paperback wrap with spine and bleed
Generating several cover directions for a novel
Browsing sample covers by genre for inspiration
Calculating spine width from page count
Exporting a 300 dpi cover file for upload
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool where you enter a book title, author and description, optionally add a reference image, choose a trim size and generate cover options (3 per run, per the page's controls). You pick one and edit the text while the spine, bleed and 300 dpi settings are calculated automatically. The output is a download ready for upload to Amazon KDP. A sample library of 20 AI-generated covers across genres is shown, with prompts and layout notes available for viewing. The page also lists a KDP cover calculator, cover sizes and spine width tools.
notable: Automatic spine width, bleed and 300 dpi calculation for KDP wraps
Choice of multiple trim sizes from 5 x 8 to 8.5 x 11 inches
Sample library of AI-generated covers by genre with viewable prompts
Uses several named AI image models for base artwork
caveats: Each generation consumes credits (12 credits per run shown); the page says 12 free credits on signup, so further use likely costs more
Page text is mostly marketing; pricing tiers are not detailed beyond the credit mention
